# Insulation Refractory

> Qingdao Laurel New Materials Co., Ltd. is a China-based manufacturer and supplier of premium insulation refractory materials including ceramic fiber, fire bricks, high alumina bricks, and silica refractories for industrial applications.

The site serves a global audience with multilingual support across 16 languages, reflecting Laurel's international reach in the refractory materials industry. As a specialized manufacturer of fire-resistant and insulating materials, the company caters to industrial sectors requiring high-performance thermal protection solutions.

## Key Topics

- Ceramic Fiber Refractory
- Fire Brick Refractory
- High Alumina Brick
- Silica Refractory
- Insulating Fire Brick
- Calcium Silicate Board
- Qingdao Laurel
- Refractory Manufacturer
- Industrial Materials
- Fire Resistance
- Thermal Insulation
- China-based Supplier
- Sino-Laurel
- Manufacturing
